name: cyberjudah-bot
description: The CyberJudah Telegram bot and Mini App worker: serves the app, the Bot API webhook, search, sharing, Stars and the daily verse.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/deploy-ambient.mjs && node scripts/deploy-recordings.mjs && node scripts/fetch-dictionary.mjs && bash scripts/prepare-assets.sh && wrangler deploy
